title: Ash Mohammad vs Shiv Raj Singh @ Lalla Babu & Anr on 20 September, 2012
judges_list: Bench: Dipak Misra, K. S. Radhakrishnan
acts_list: Section 439 of the CrPC in respect of serious offences
outcome_summary: The Supreme Court sets aside the High Court's order granting bail to a history-sheeter accused of kidnapping, citing the need to consider criminal antecedents and broader concerns when deciding bail applications.
conditions: accused to surrender forthwith or face custody immediately
